name: Gambia

fees.name: Single-entry visa (embassy-issued, Gambia High Commission London)
fees.validity: single journey; short visit up to 90 days
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa; fee as published by the London High Commission (embassy fees vary by mission)
fees.notes: Fee schedules differ by Gambian mission; London charges GBP 40 single entry. The Washington DC embassy fee is widely reported around USD 100-139 but could not be verified on an official page, so it is not recorded as a separate amount.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa (embassy-issued, Gambia High Commission London)
fees.validity: multiple journeys, validity up to 12 months
fees.notes: Multiple Journey Visa valid for stated number of journeys within up to 12 months per Gambia Immigration Department.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (Banjul International Airport and gazetted ports of entry)
fees.applies: travellers from countries without a Gambian diplomatic mission / eligible nationalities; some nationalities also need prior entry clearance
fees.notes: Gambia Immigration Department confirms visa on arrival is available at gazetted ports of entry, but publishes no fee amount. Third-party sources report roughly USD 100-150; amount left null pending official confirmation. Payable in cash.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.validity: transit en route to onward destination
fees.notes: Transit visa category exists per Gambia Immigration Department; no separate fee published (London High Commission lists only single GBP 40 / multiple GBP 60).

vfs.note: No outsourced visa centre (VFS/TLScontact/BLS) for travel TO The Gambia; applications go directly to Gambian embassies/high commissions or visa on arrival.

free_visa_notes: Citizens of ECOWAS states, the UK, EU member states, Commonwealth countries and states with reciprocal visa-exemption agreements do not need a visa for stays up to 90 days. Separately, ALL passengers (except diplomats and children 2 and under) pay a Securiport airport security fee of D1000 (~USD 20) in cash on both arrival and departure - this is not a visa fee.
